name: cicada-local-tasks
description: Local Cicada task authority for explicit AI execution, stages, results, and human review.

interface.shortDescription: Read and report work against native Cicada tasks
interface.longDescription: Uses an explicitly configured local Cicada profile and named-pipe client. Reuses authorized UUIDs and revisions; Cicada remains the task authority and human review controls acceptance.
defaultPrompt: For authorized work, reuse the exact Cicada UUID and revision; report observed runs and leave result acceptance to human review.
